payment-notice.v3.revision_rule: Original event, buyer, order and durable availability time must match the retained intent.
payment-notice.v3.duplicate_rule: Identical receipt is idempotent; conflicting receipt is denied.
payment-notice.v3.uncertain_rule: Keep notification pending and retry the same receipt.

recovery.missing_operator: Reject new events as unavailable before notice persistence. Preserve the event reference for retry.
recovery.ownership: Persist one operator per event atomically with the notice; retries never reassign it.
recovery.escalation_due: Durable notice availability plus 48 hours without acknowledgement.
recovery.escalation: Record escalation and bilingual next action durably; resolve only after receipt acknowledgement.
recovery.migration: Assign existing pending notices before delivery using their original availability time.
recovery.connected_proof: Database migration, configured operator identity and operational response remain deferred.
